content: Omwoyo Omweru ogwa Katonda aikire ku awantu
Olwa omugomo ogwa *Pendekosti
gwatuuka, awalonzi awa Yesu woona waikumia alala mu enyumba.
Waaizukirra ni wawurra erioga eringi erifwana eria omuyaga omuzito oguwuuta ni guemerra ku igulu ri-ingira ri-izula enyumba eya waawangamo.
Nikuemao waawona ewintu ewifwana ne endimi ezia omurro ni zifuma enyingi kandi ziagwirra ku omuntu ki omuntu owawanga mu enyumba omwo.
Woona waaizuziwua no *Omwoyo Omweru ogwa Katonda mala waatanika okuwoola eminwa egigawukane-gawukaane, owuagani ni kiomo Omwoyo Omweru yawa-aa amaani.
Okwo kwatuukra na *Awayaudi awatiire Katonda awaawanga ni wamenyere Yerusaleemu na awandi awaemere embega ziona ezia ku ekialo kuno, waazre Yerusaleemu mu omugomo ogwa Pendekosti.
Olwa waawurra erioga erio, omurima ogwa awantu gwaikumia asi ao okuwona ekintu ekiikola. Waaluguula ino olwa omuntu ki omuntu yawurra awalonzi awa Yesu ni wagamba-gamba mu omunwa gwae omwene.
Kino kia-amba awantu wano eminwa, mala watanika okuiwuuzia aweene watino, “Awiifu, awantu wano woona kane ngawaema Galiili?

Ekigera ni tuwurra ni wawoola eminwa egigawukane-gawukaane niki? Niki ekigera ni nyingeeno twona kiomo turi ano tutino, omuntu ki omuntu awurra no omunwa gwawu nigwo ogwa wawoola ni kandi tuemere mu ewialo ewigawukaane? Awandi ku ifwe waemere
Paasia, Miidia, Elaami ni Mesopotaamia, na awandi waemere Yudeea, Kapadookia, Pontuusi ni *Eesia. Na awandi woona waemere mu ewialo ewia
Firiigia, Pamfiilia, Misiri ne ekialo ekia Liibia ampi no omugizi ogwa Kureene, na awaemere Rooma.

Lwona aa turi ano kukawa mbwe awandi na Awayaudi, awandi na awantu awaagaluka mu ediini eya Awayaudi, na awandi waemere Kireete, kandi awandi na awa Araabu, ni tuwurra awantu wano ni wagamba-gamba mala mu eminwa giifu aweene kandi wawoola ewintu ewikate-kaate ewia Katonda amiire okukola!”
Amangʼana gano ga-amba awantu wano eminwa kandi okuingirizia kwawateeka aa waaiwuzianga aweene mbwe, “Awiifu, kuno kulaganaki?”
Ni kukawa kutio, awantu wandi waatanika okusekera awalonzi awa Yesu wano ni wawoola watino, “Awantu wano andi wanywere amalwa nikio ekigera ni wagamba-gamba watio.”
Petro agamba-gambra awantu

Nikuemao, Petro yaimerra alala na *awatumwa awa Yesu awiina waae ikumi ni mulala. Yagamba-gambra awantu no omwoyo oguri kungulu na awoola otino, “Inywe awantu awamenyere Yerusaleemu ano, na awiifu Awayaudi mwona, musarigire mbalage ekintu ekiikola kino kugere mukimanye.
Awantu awa muwona wano ngawakanywa amalwa kiomo muingirizia mutio yaaya, ni lwona nikwo ziri enyinga isatu ezia kunkio, iwo wanywerei amalwa ago?
Ewiikola wino ne ewintu ewia Yoeli *omugambi owa Katonda yagamba-gambako emiaka emikulu egiawita olwa yawoola otino:

content.text: “ ‘Inze *Omwami Katonda mboola mbwe, amiire aga owutuuko,
nyiza okutumra awantu woona Omwoyo gwange Omweru.
Awaala na awazia wiinyu waaza okugamba amangʼana agaemere ku inze,
lwona owueru owua ewintu wiange wuuza okusasukra awawuuka wiinyu
kandi *awagaaka wiinyu waaza okuloota amalooto aganyemereko.
Namba *awakurumu wange awekikazi na awekisaaza,
nyiza okuwatumra Omwoyo gwange Omweru mu amiire ago,
kandi woona warigamba amangʼana agaemere ku inze Omwami Katonda.
Ndirikola amankono ku igulu kungulu
kandi ewintu ewiluguulwa wiriikola ansi ku ekialo.
Muriwona omurro na amasaai ne eriosi eriambanre ti ku ekialo kuno.
Enyanga erimwama ti,
no omwenzi guriwa omwakanyu ka ki amasaai.
Wino wiriikola no *Owuire owua Omwami owunene kandi owuluguulwa wukiari okutuuka.
Mu amiire ago omuntu-umuntu orieta eriina eria Omwami mbwe amusaasre, arinunulwa!’ ”

content: Petro yagia emberi na awalaga otino, “Inywe Awaisraeli, mutege amatwi muwurre amangʼana gano. Yesu Omunazareeti yawanga omuntu owa Katonda yalagana mbwe nio omulowole waae olwa yakola amankono amangi ne ewintu ewikate-kaate ewiluguulwa okuwitra ku iye. Inywe mwona muwimanyire aeniki ewintu ewio yawikola agati iinyu mu ekialo kiinyu muno.
Yateewua mu amakono giinyu kandi mwamuita olwa mwamuta mu amakono aga awantu awatari Awayaudi *awaamuwamba ku omusalaaba. Ne ekio kiaikola kiomo Katonda yawanga na amiire okutaao kale.
Ni Katonda yamuziusia amutoola ku awafu, kutio yamusiwula mu owululu owua olumbe aeniki Yesu ngakaesanga okufwa ilala.
“Omwami Daudi oona yamugamba-gambako na awoola otino,

content.text: “ ‘Nyawona Omwami na ari ampi ni inze enyinga ziona
kandi ari nyakukono kwange okusaaza, kutio ngʼanyiza okutia ekintu-ukintu.
Kutio ndi no owusangaavu mu omwoyo gwange
kandi ngamba-gamba no owusangaavu,
aeniki ndi no owuolu mu omwoyo gwange
ni manyire mbwe kuwuene ni iwue ooza okuntunzia.
Manyire mbwe ngoriganya oreke omwoyo gwange guweere mu ekialo ekia awafu amiire goona,
lwona ngorireka omuwiri ogwa omukurumu waao guwole.
Omiire okugera manya engira ezia owulamu.
Kandi ooza okugera mbe omusangaavu ino emberi waao.’

content: “Awiifu mbalaga kuwuene mbwe guukwa iifu Daudi yafwa kandi ya-awirwa. Kuri kuwuene mbwe ekiwaga kiae kikiario aa turi ano nawuno reero.
Okuwa kwae okwa yawanga omugambi owa Katonda kandi okumanya okwa yamanya mbwe Katonda yamuifuuwira mbwe aaza okuta omulala ku awiizukulu waae awe omwami,
yakiwona kale kandi yagamba-gamba ku okuziuka okwa *Kristo mbwe omuwiri gwae ngaguuza okulawirwa ku awafu kandi ngaguuza okurekwa guwole.
“Yesu wazane ono, Katonda yamala okumuziusia kandi ifwe turi awawoni ku ekingʼana ekio.

Amiire okugingiriziwua kungulu aa aikaale nyakukono okusaaza okwa swae Omwami Katonda kandi Katonda amiire okumu-aa Omwoyo gwae Omweru kiomo yawanga na amiire okumuifuuwira okutufukako. Ni iye ogerre ne ewintu ewia muwurra kandi ewia muwona wino ni wiikola.
Omwami Daudi ngakaniina agia ku igulu yaaya, ni kukawa kutio iye ni iye owawoola omwene otino, ‘Omwami Katonda yalaga Omwami wange otino, ikala nyakukono kwange okusaaza
nawuno kutuuke ntoole awazigu waao woona nte ansi otaze na amagulu gaao.’ ”
Petro yamariizia na awoola otino, “Kutio, inywe Awaisraeli, muwe no okumanya kuwuene mbwe Yesu owa mwawamba ku *omusalaaba ono nio owa Katonda amiire okulowola mbwe awe Omwami kandi *Meesia.”
Olwa Petro yamala okuwalaga otio, amangʼana ago gaafumuta emioyo egia awantu ino, kutio waawuuzia Petro na awatumwa wandi watino, “Awiifu, katio ifwe, ekia tusugaane tukole niki?”

Petro yawairania na awalaga otino, “Omuntu ki omuntu agaluke no omwoyo gwae ogwa munsi areke amawi kandi abatiiswe ku eriina eria Yesu Kristo kugere Katonda amurekere amawi gaae nikwo aaza okutuukra Omwoyo Omweru ogwa Katonda.

Muuza okumutuukra aeniki Katonda yamala okuifuuwa na awoola mbwe, inywe na awiizukulu wiinyu alala no omuntu-umuntu namba oemere mu ewialo ewia ale, awantu woona awa Katonda aetre waaza okutuukra Omwoyo gwae Omweru.”
Petro yawalaga amangʼana amangi aga Katonda na awasiagizia otino, “Awiifu muinunule ku eminyako-nyaako egiiza okuamba ikula eria enkola embiiwi eno!”
Nyanga olwo awantu awakasuga elufu wisatu waaingizia amangʼana aga Katonda aga Petro yawalaga nikwo waabatiiswa kandi waisonga ku owulala owua awalonzi awa Yesu.
Okuemera nyanga olwo, awantu wano waata emioyo giawu ku okuwurra engerera eya awatumwa, okuikumia alala, okuria isawo eria Omwami, no okusawa Katonda.
Owulala owua awalonzi awa Yesu
Awatumwa awa Yesu wano waakola amankono amangi ne ewintu ewingi ewiluguulwa ewiagera waeewua owuti ino.
Awantu woona awaawanga no okuganya ku Yesu waawanga alala enyinga ziona kandi waasangirizianga ewintu wiawu.
Waaesanga okuguzia ewintu ewia waawanga nawio, na amasendi aga watuukiire waagawananga agati yaawu aweene nikulondokana no okuagala okwa omuntu yawanga nakwo.
Owuire ki owuire waaikumianga mu ekaalu kandi waarianga isawo eria Omwami alala ni wari mu emigizi giawu. Waaikumianga alala mu ewidiori ni waria ne emioyo emisiza kandi ni wari no owusangaavu,
ni watondowola Katonda kandi waagonziwua na awantu woona. Owuire ki owuire Katonda yasonganga mu owulala wuawu awantu awaanunulwanga ku eriina eria Yesu.

footnotes.text: *Pendekosti no owuire owua amakumi ataanu okuemera owuire owua *Pasaaka. Nyanga olwo *Awayaudi wareeta engaano mu *ekaalu.
